messages:
taylor: opened PR 913 with a small how-to: run the onprem installer against an HSM emulator (softhsm2) for local QA + add nftables and netplan examples for dual-stack installs. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/913 :memo:
ben: nice. can we include an exact softhsm2 init command and systemd unit so engs can reproduce? also add the env var the installer reads to skip real HSM detection for tests.
anya: security callout: mark the emulator steps explicitly "not for production" and add a short paragraph about why PKCS#11 pin/key storage must be moved to an HSM in prod.
jon: request: add a tiny troubleshooting table for common failure modes when softhsm reports "token not found" (wrong token label, permissions on /var/lib/softhsm, SELinux denials).
taylor: ack. plan to add: - softhsm2 init example - systemd unit to start a test hsm socket - `REDWOOD_HSM_EMULATOR=1` env var note - nftables rule snippet for IPv4/IPv6 dualstack - netplan YAML sample for isolated subnets - quick go SDK snippet showing cached KMS cert usage
ben: for nftables please show the minimal set: allow installer ip ranges, allow DNS to resolver, allow outbound port 443 to KMS endpoint, and show conntrack helper note.
taylor: adding the nftables snippet now:
```bash
# minimal nftables rules for installer host
sudo nft add table inet redwood
sudo nft 'add chain inet redwood input { type filter hook input priority 0; policy drop; }'
sudo nft 'add rule inet redwood input ct state established,related accept'
sudo nft add rule inet redwood input ip saddr 10.0.0.0/16 tcp dport {22,80,443} accept
sudo nft add rule inet redwood input ip6 saddr fd00::/48 tcp dport {22,80,443} accept
sudo nft add rule inet redwood input udp dport 53 accept  # DNS
```
anya: for the netplan sample, include a note to set renderer: networkd for servers. also include `routes:` for the private KMS subnet to avoid hairpin.
taylor: netplan YAML will go into the PR too. adding softhsm init and systemd unit:
```bash
# init token (example)
SOFTHSM2_CONF=/etc/softhsm2.conf
mkdir -p /var/lib/softhsm/tokens
softhsm2-util --init-token --slot 0 --label redwood-test --pin 1234 --so-pin 5678

# systemd unit (socket activation)
[Unit]
Description=SoftHSM2 PKCS#11 emulator for docs QA
After=network.target

[Service]
ExecStart=/usr/bin/softhsm2-util --show-slots
Restart=on-failure
User=softhsm

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
jon: add SELinux troubleshooting: `ausearch -m avc -ts recent` and a note to check `ls -Z /var/lib/softhsm` perms.
ben: for the Go SDK snippet: show a minimal approach to try KMS and fall back to cached cert file. keep it very short, non-opinionated.
taylor: Go snippet added:
```go
// redwood-go example: prefer remote KMS, fallback to cached cert
package main
import (
  "fmt"
  "io/ioutil"
  "net/http"
  "time"
)
func fetchTokenFromKMS(url string) (string, error) {
  c := http.Client{Timeout: 2 * time.Second}
  resp, err := c.Get(url + "/token")
  if err != nil { return "", err }
  defer resp.Body.Close()
  b, _ := ioutil.ReadAll(resp.Body)
  return string(b), nil
}
func readCachedToken(path string) (string, error) {
  b, err := ioutil.ReadFile(path)
  return string(b), err
}
func main() {
  token, err := fetchTokenFromKMS("https://kms.internal.example")
  if err != nil {
    token, _ = readCachedToken("/var/lib/redwood/kms-token.cached")
  }
  fmt.Println("token:", token)
}
```
anya: nit: mention file permissions for cached token (0600) and that cached tokens expire—advise a short sentence about token TTL and how to refresh in airgapped sites.
taylor: good call. adding TTL: "cached tokens are valid for up to 24h by default; offline refresh requires manual upload or scheduled token exchange via bastion"
